glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形): the calyx of a flower. 不 was composed into a phono-semantic character with the pictograph for mouth (口), to form 否, representing “no” (negation). This composed meaning then spread back to the original character 不, making it a synonym of 否. A new character of 柎 was eventually created to represent the original meaning of calyx. Following Shuowen’s interpretation, Karlgren and Wieger interpret it as a bird flying toward the sky (一). The sky being the limit for the bird, thus the idea of negation.
shuowen: Following Shuowen’s interpretation, Karlgren and Wieger interpret it as a bird flying toward the sky (一).
senses: (preceding verbs and adjectives) not; un-; in-; il-; im-; ir-; a(n)-; dys-
(between a verb and a complement) cannot
[fǒu] (obsolete in standard Chinese) alternative form of 否
[bū] only used in 不不鐙兒.
